title: Door Zone, Ice
scene: Ice in the Kent Station lot at morning, the stalls a rink. You stopped along a row of dead cars to make the last drop on foot. Marisol is coming up the painted aisle in the right glass, slow because ice, still unafraid. Your door is the next thing she will occupy if you open it like a person who is late. The Dutch Reach exists because of this exact geometry: far hand, look, then open. Your left hand wants the handle because you have always opened a door with that hand. The insulin crate is in your right. That is the trap.
decision: Marisol is in the right glass and you need the door. How do you get out?

options.text: Far hand to the handle, look in the glass, then open a crack and look again
options.result: Right hand across. Your torso turns. The glass has her. You wait. She passes with three feet of ice and does not look at you. You open after. The crate follows. Nobody on the ice had to choose between a door and a wheel.

options.text: Open it now — she has time to stop on ice
options.result: The door occupies her line. Ice does not let her stop. The bar-end takes the steel and she goes down. Quiet lot, loud metal. She gets up. You will see her in every glass for a week.

options.text: Crack the window and tell her to go around
options.result: She cannot hear you through wind and ice and a moving bike. She is already in the door when you finish the sentence. Talking is not a look.

options.text: Get out the passenger side to avoid her entirely
options.result: The crates are in the way. You climb. The passenger door opens into a cart corral on ice. You fall. She passes a car that is now a spectacle. You avoided a door zone by inventing a worse one.

debrief: The door zone is the strip a bicyclist dies in. Dutch Reach: far hand, which turns your body toward the mirror, then look, then open. Ice makes her stopping distance a fantasy. Your wait is the three feet.

source.teaching_target: Before opening a door, check the mirror and blind area for bicyclists; use the far-hand reach so your body turns to look.

image_brief.subject: Marisol approaching in the right-side glass, ice on the aisle, the Pink Menace's door still closed
image_brief.foreground: interior door handle and riveted steel, Ali's left hand already hovering
image_brief.midground: her front wheel in the strip the door will occupy
image_brief.background: Kent Station lot, morning ice, dead cars, pale sky
image_brief.read: the door has not opened yet and her wheel is already in the arc
